bio: Paris built Paddock Tracker and edits it. He writes most of the Formula 1 coverage here, from Thursday previews through practice, qualifying and race reports to the lap-by-lap race chronologies, and covers MotoGP alongside it. The data pipelines behind every schedule, standings table and results board are his too.

Stylianos writes the Greek-language Formula 1 coverage on Paddock. His team-by-team report cards work through the whole grid after a race weekend and set out what each team got right and what it got wrong.
Panagiotis writes Formula 1 opinion for Paddock. His first piece covered the 2026 Hungarian Grand Prix and the moment Lando Norris finally won a race in his title defence.
